description: large stone slabs: base colour #D2CEDB, a few big rectangular slabs in slightly different shades of the base colour, thin gaps between them. It belongs to a district of the town with this look, which everything in the district shares: a cheerful old town in cherry blossom season: frames in cream white and warm wood, shutters and doors in soft pink, mint green or sky blue, rounded friendly shapes, flowers wherever they fit
